summary: Static + testID wiring + lint + bundle verification for 3 NEW FEATURES (VOID Transaction, RESET Demo Data, Invoice CK-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) in Cemara Kopi POS. ALL CHECKS PASS. Invoice generation is atomic (INSERT OR IGNORE + UPDATE + SELECT inside withTransactionAsync, padStart(4,'0')). Schema migrations correct (status/voided_at/voided_by/void_reason columns + idempotent ALTER TABLE; invoice_counters & audit_log tables with idx_audit_created & idx_tx_status indexes). voidTransaction restores stock by iterating transaction_items, updates status='VOID', writes audit_log — all atomic. Reports screen wires reports-search, r-status-all/NORMAL/VOID chips (VOID chip rendered with danger color), void-transaction-btn (admin-gated via isAdmin), void-reason multiline TextInput, void-confirm button. Detail modal renders VOID badge + voided_by/voided_at/void_reason notice + strikethrough total. Settings screen has 'Zona Berbahaya' (admin-only) with reset-demo-button → 3-step flow: reset-step1-continue → reset-step2-continue (reset-toggle-backup defaults TRUE) → reset-step3 with reset-pin-input (secureTextEntry, centered letterSpacing) + reset-confirm. verifyAdminPin queries users WHERE role='admin' AND password=? — correct. resetDemoData calls createBackup if withBackup!==false, then DELETEs transaction_items/transactions/cash_flow/draft_orders/invoice_counters inside withTransactionAsync, then logs audit. PRESERVES products/users/settings/backups as required. dashboardSummary today/week/month/top-products/salesByDay all filter status='NORMAL'. listTransactions accepts from/to/limit/status/search with case-insensitive LIKE on code+customer_name. Lint: 0 errors, 0 warnings on all 5 reference files. Android bundle compiles (Android Bundled 11296ms, 1699 modules). End-to-end SQLite flows still un-testable on web preview (WASM worker — main agent must rely on Expo Go on Android device for runtime verification).
action_items: Optional end-to-end verification on a physical Android device via Expo Go: (a) create a transaction, confirm invoice code matches CK-YYYYMMDD-0001 then 0002 next, and resets to 0001 next day; (b) VOID a transaction as admin, confirm stock is restored, dashboard revenue drops, and detail modal shows VOID badge + reason; (c) attempt VOID as kasir — button must be hidden; (d) run Reset Demo Data full 3-step flow with wrong PIN (must error) then correct PIN (must wipe target tables, keep products/users/settings/backups, and write audit_log entry).
Optional: Surface audit_log somewhere in the admin UI (currently listAuditLog exists but no screen renders it) — useful for traceability of voids + resets.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice generation correctly uses INSERT OR IGNORE + UPDATE seq=seq+1 + SELECT inside withTransactionAsync — atomicity guaranteed by SQLite transaction. padStart(4,'0') gives the 4-digit XXXX format. Daily reset is implicit (date key changes).
voidTransaction is fully atomic: stock restoration + status update + audit_log entry all inside a single withTransactionAsync — partial-failure safe.
verifyAdminPin restricts to role='admin' so a kasir password cannot authorize a reset even if known.

resetDemoData uses withTransactionAsync to atomically delete the 5 target tables + write audit row; createBackup runs BEFORE the transaction so a backup failure does not block reset but is silently swallowed (try/catch). Consider surfacing backup failure to the user (toast already shows 'backup dibuat' only on success — acceptable).

Reports KPI card derives totalRev from `txs.filter(t=>t.status==='NORMAL')` so the in-screen totals also exclude voided txns regardless of the active status chip — consistent with dashboardSummary's status='NORMAL' filtering.
Settings 'Zona Berbahaya' section + reset-demo-button are wrapped in `{isAdmin && ...}` so kasir cannot see or trigger reset. Good role gating.
Search/code+customer_name filter uses LOWER() on both sides — case-insensitive. LIKE wildcards correctly escaped with template literals (no SQL injection risk because of parameterized queries).

transactions.voided_by column stores the displayed NAME (user.name) while audit_log.user_id stores the actual id — both populated by voidTransaction. Acceptable; just be aware that voided_by is a name, not an id.
Schema migrations are idempotent: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handles fresh installs, ALTER TABLE wrapped in try/catch handles pre-existing DBs without the new columns. Safe for over-the-air updates.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on static review + testID wiring + lint + Android bundle. Runtime SQLite flows not exercisable on web preview.

seed_data_creation: None. SQLite seeds admin/admin123 + kasir/kasir123 + products/categories/settings on first native run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline-first app. expo-sqlite WASM worker fails on web preview — login submission and any data flow can only be exercised via Expo Go on physical Android. For static iterations: (1) verify testID strings exactly match the spec, (2) confirm withTransactionAsync wraps all multi-statement DB operations, (3) ensure schema migrations are idempotent (ALTER TABLE in try/catch), (4) run yarn lint and check /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log for 'Android Bundled'. All 3 new features are correctly wired per spec as of iteration 2.
rca_of_issue: Not a bug-fix iteration — this is a feature-addition verification. The 3 features are correctly implemented per spec: (a) Atomic per-day invoice counter (CK-YYYYMMDD-XXXX) via SQLite transaction; (b) Soft-delete VOID with stock restoration + audit trail, admin-gated; (c) 3-step Reset Demo Data with Admin PIN verification, optional auto-backup, audit log entry, and preservation of products/users/settings/backups.
